title: Com9 Scene Light
subtitle: High-output 9-LED scene and flood light for work trucks, utility vehicles, and service fleets. Available in Black or White housing.
description: The Federal Signal Com9 Scene Light delivers high-output flood illumination for night operations on utility, municipal, and service vehicles. Its 9-LED housing provides increased output over the Com7 for wider work areas, mounting to cab exteriors, mirror arms, and equipment racks for reliable scene lighting after dark.
summary_bullets: Available in Black or White housing

features: Wide-angle beam pattern for work-zone illumination
Sealed, IP-rated housing for harsh environments
Surface-mount installation on cab exteriors, mirror arms, and equipment racks
Available in Black or White housing
benefits: Higher LED count than the Com7 for wider scene coverage
Housing color options allow the fixture to match cab trim
